evals.prompt: Research Sentry (sentry.io) and add their core features to a new backlog file at /tmp/eval1-backlog.md
evals.expected_output: A new backlog file at /tmp/eval1-backlog.md containing multiple BL-XXX numbered items starting at BL-001, organized into sections with emoji headers, each with a one-paragraph description adapted to developer portal context. Sources cited at the bottom. No enterprise compliance features included. A summary message provided.
expectations: The backlog file is created at /tmp/eval1-backlog.md
BL numbering starts at BL-001 and increments without gaps
At least 3 sections are present, each with an emoji in the header
Each BL item has a one-paragraph description (not a stub or placeholder)
At least one section covers error tracking or crash reporting
At least one section covers performance monitoring or tracing
No items mention SSO, SAML, RBAC, SOC 2, HIPAA, GDPR, audit logs, or multi-tenancy
A sources line citing sentry.io appears at the bottom of the file
A summary message is provided to the user after appending, stating how many items were added

evals.prompt: I have an existing backlog at evals/files/sample-backlog.md. Research Linear (linear.app) and append their features to it.
evals.expected_output: The sample-backlog.md file updated with new sections appended after the existing content. BL numbering continues from BL-006 (since the file ends at BL-005). Section numbering starts at 3. No duplication of the existing alerting or dashboard items. Sources line updated to include linear.app.
expectations: New BL items start at BL-006 (continuing from BL-005 in the existing file)
New section numbering starts at 3 (continuing from section 2 in the existing file)
No BL items duplicate the concepts already covered (alerting, alert routing, escalation, dashboards, deploy tracking)
At least one new section covers issue tracking or project management
At least one new section covers engineering workflow or cycle time features
Each new BL item has a one-paragraph description in developer portal context
The sources line at the bottom is updated to include linear.app
A summary message is provided stating how many new items were added and which sections are new

evals.prompt: Research Okta (okta.com) and add relevant features to a new backlog at /tmp/eval3-backlog.md
evals.expected_output: A backlog file with developer-facing Okta features (developer APIs, authentication SDKs, OAuth/OIDC flows for apps, identity verification for user flows) but with enterprise overhead features (SSO enforcement, SAML for workforce, RBAC administration, compliance reporting, audit logs) filtered out. The summary message should note which categories were filtered.
expectations: The backlog file is created at /tmp/eval3-backlog.md
BL numbering starts at BL-001
No items describe SSO enforcement, SAML workforce federation, RBAC admin consoles, SOC 2 compliance controls, or audit log dashboards
At least one item covers developer-relevant authentication concepts (OAuth flows, token management, or identity APIs that an app would integrate)
The summary message explicitly notes that enterprise/compliance features were filtered out
Each included BL item is framed in terms of what a developer portal would expose to engineering teams, not Okta's marketing language
